summary.prose: Building this fix makes the analyzer's two plan-making calls expressible for codex. The decomposer gets a params table and a per-type schema, plus one shared step in both of its entry points that removes nulls and rejects keys a type does not declare. The planner gets a wire-schema builder: per template, with JSON-string slots for open objects and fallbacks for shapes that cannot be embedded. Its prompt, output shape and correction retries are updated to show that wire form. The build ends with a live codex check of the complete schemas, one full test sweep and a daemon rollout confirmed by a one-shot analysis on codex.

tasks.title: Exploration params table
tasks.summary: Add a params table beside the explorations: one entry per EXPLORATION_TYPES type (20 today) listing each param's name and value type, from src/prompts/analyze/decompose.system.md and the runners' reads. From it, build each type's closed params branch: every param optional, typed T | null | `$eN...` placeholder string.
acceptanceChecks: Every EXPLORATION_TYPES entry has exactly one table entry, checked against the type list rather than a hard-coded count
Each branch is a closed object with no required param, and each value admits null and a placeholder string
Each documented params example in the decomposer prompt validates against its type's branch

tests.name: every exploration type has exactly one params branch, derived from EXPLORATION_TYPES
each branch is closed, requires no param, and admits null and a placeholder string for every value
every documented params example in the decomposer prompt validates against its type's branch

tasks.title: Reshape DECOMPOSE_SCHEMA and share the decomposer params step
tasks.summary: DECOMPOSE_SCHEMA's params becomes the anyOf of the t1 branches. decompose and finalizeDecompose share one step, run before topology validation, that removes null params and rejects keys the exploration's type does not declare (DecomposerSchemaUnrecoverable). The decomposer prompt gains the line that an optional param may be null, meaning absent.
acceptanceChecks: codexStrictSchema(DECOMPOSE_SCHEMA) has no object without properties and none whose additionalProperties is not false
decompose and finalizeDecompose drop null params, and reject an undeclared key with DecomposerSchemaUnrecoverable
In the one-shot driver that failure takes the freeform.probe fallback without executing the plan
Empty params and placeholder strings stay valid

tests.name: the codex strict copy of DECOMPOSE_SCHEMA contains no object without properties and no object whose additionalProperties is not false
decompose and finalizeDecompose remove null params, so the executor receives today's params

an exploration carrying a key its type does not declare fails with DecomposerSchemaUnrecoverable at decompose and at finalizeDecompose, and the one-shot driver runs the freeform.probe fallback instead of the plan
empty params, a placeholder string where an array is expected, and a plan omitting optional params validate against DECOMPOSE_SCHEMA

tasks.title: Planner wire schema: per-template wire form
tasks.summary: Add the builder that turns one template's inputSchema into its wire branch: closed objects keep their structure with optional properties nullable and not required; open objects at object-only positions become JSON-string slots whose paths are recorded; a root anyOf-of-required is left out of the branch.
acceptanceChecks: Each of the 27 built-in templates yields a branch, and exactly 9 of them have slots, at the expected paths
A slot is placed only where the original schema admits nothing but an object
The adherence templates' root one-of-three is absent from their branches

tests.name: the 27 built-in templates yield a branch each, with exactly their 9 slot sets at the expected paths
a slot is placed only at a position the original schema restricts to an object, and the adherence root one-of-three is left out of the branch

tasks.title: Planner wire schema: fallbacks, identity and cache
tasks.summary: Assemble the per-call wire schema from PLAN_TASK_SCHEMA and the effective catalog, without $id. Fall back to a whole-params JSON-string slot for a template with no inputSchema, with $ref/$defs/definitions/$id/$anchor, with a union/conditional/multi-type keyword other than the root anyOf-of-required, or whose branch fails a trial compile under the wire validators' dialects. Build each catalog's schema once, keyed by a SHA-256 fingerprint of its templates' ids, revisions and inputSchemas.
acceptanceChecks: Each fallback condition yields a whole-params slot, and no built-in template falls back
Repeated and recursive builds compile through validateAgainstSchema and validateCodexReply without an id collision
Catalogs that share template ids but differ in schema get different wire schemas
The codex strict copy of the built-in wire schema for every target has no open object

tests.name: no inputSchema, a local reference, a union with a string, and a draft-07 tuple each yield a whole-params slot, and no built-in template falls back
repeated and recursive wire-schema builds with identical and different catalogs compile through validateAgainstSchema and validateCodexReply without an id collision
two catalogs sharing a template id with different inputSchemas get different wire schemas
the codex strict copy of the built-in planner wire schema for every target contains no open object

tasks.title: runPlanner sends the wire schema and decodes the reply
tasks.summary: runPlanner sends the t4 wire schema for its effective catalog. After the reply, for each task, it parses the JSON strings at its template's recorded slot paths back into objects (a parse failure is reported through the existing planner failure path) and, before decoding, removes the nulls the wire form forced at structural positions (user decision A, 2026-10-24: slot JSON contents and whole-params slots reach INV-5 as the model wrote them), then runs INV-5 as today.
acceptanceChecks: A supplied template's scopeRef {kind:'repo', value:'/r'} round-trips through a slot into INV-5 unchanged

Supplied templates with no inputSchema, with local $ref/definitions, with a union of open object and string (native 'hello' and '{"x":1}'), and with a draft-07 tuple ({pair:['x',7]}) each round-trip as a whole-params slot and pass INV-5 as today
Nulls the wire form forced, including in nested objects and array items, are removed before INV-5; slot JSON contents and whole-params slots reach INV-5 as written
The adherence one-of-three rule still fails a task with none of the three
Invalid JSON in a slot is reported, and nothing partial reaches INV-5

tests.name: runPlanner sends a wire schema covering exactly its effective catalog, and a supplied scopeRef round-trips through a slot into INV-5 unchanged
supplied templates with no inputSchema, local references, a union with a string, and a draft-07 tuple round-trip as whole-params slots and pass INV-5 as today
nulls the wire form forced are removed at structural positions only: slot contents and whole-params reach INV-5 as written, and the adherence one-of-three rule still holds
invalid JSON in a slot is reported through the planner failure path and nothing partial reaches INV-5

tasks.title: Planner messages show the wire form
tasks.summary: Amend the planner system prompt's params rule (the slot exception with the aggregator example, and nulls mean absent); print the call's wire schema as the output shape; list each template's slot paths in the rendered catalog; re-encode the echoed rejected plan and the offending-task snippet to wire form on correction retries.
acceptanceChecks: The output-shape block is the call's wire schema, not PLAN_TASK_SCHEMA
The catalog lists each template's slot paths and marks whole-params slots
A correction retry echoes the rejected plan in wire form
The prompt names the slot exception with the aggregator example

tests.name: the planner's output-shape block is the call's wire schema and the catalog lists each template's slot paths
a correction retry echoes the rejected plan and the offending task in wire form
the planner system prompt names the slot exception with the aggregator example and allows null for absent optional values
